findings.summary: Reader manifest HTTP and transport failure mappings are not directly covered by the named unit test.
findings.consequence: A regression in Reader-specific 404/422/503, malformed JSON, transport rejection, or abort behavior could pass the current Reader tests; only the analogous Editor client behavior is asserted later in the same file.
findings.evidence: The owned unit maps 404 and 422 to Reader page not found at lines 103-105, 503 to unavailable at line 106, malformed JSON via the catch block at lines 90-93, and abort rethrow at line 91. test/unit/work-manifest-client.spec.ts covers Reader success and validation failures but repository search found those failure-boundary cases only for fetchEditorManifest.
findings.recommendation: Add Reader-side tests mirroring the existing Editor manifest status, malformed JSON, transport rejection, and abort cases, asserting the public Reader statusCode/statusMessage outcomes.
